data_and_derive_review: Obj is a Clone/Debug/static Rust marker, not finite enumeration or mathematical Set membership. EMAlgebra action and carrier fields are unchecked mutable candidate data. Morphism owns a private boxed Fn with no law constructor. AlgebraLaw and LawCheckError are closed tagged data with exact usize payloads. AlgebraSampleCheck fields are public observation counts, forgeable metadata rather than a certificate. Standard derived Clone/Eq/Debug preserve their fields; no serde or authority parser is present.
trait_and_macro_review: Monad unit/bind/fmap signatures are caller contracts, with only the explicit join default implemented here. Blanket Obj and Phantom impls do not prove laws. Deprecated attributes document unverified legacy queries. Standard Debug builder writes only a fixed label and propagates errors; no opaque computation macro or unfinished proof is hidden.
invariant_argument: Rust Maybe::Nothing/Just map structurally to Option.none/some. EMSamples proves bind left/right/associativity, fmap identity/composition and join/free-action unit/associativity for this concrete pure value model. Monad trait implementations remain unchecked caller contracts; the theorem is not generalized to arbitrary Rust implementations or effects.

EMSamples.step and scan_ok_iff mirror observed copy equality before observed law equality, exact phase/index refusal and ordered finite iteration. The two separate Vec enumerations reset indices per law; actual indices are below their Vec length and counts are those finite usize lengths, with no narrowing or unchecked arithmetic.

The algebra sequence scans all unit observations before associativity observations, and returns only the two supplied counts on success. The morphism sequence applies the same step to its supplied wrapped values. Empty success is vacuous and supplies no domain coverage; generic callbacks can be stateful, so observations are not universal mathematical proofs.

The single private checked_clone returns the very copy it compared, not a second clone. Native static Odd and stateful SwitchClone fixtures test both rejected non-preservation and exactly-once checked input routing. No assumption of globally lawful Clone is silently inferred from Rust Clone bounds.

The historical G2 E false-acceptance source is retained. Both no-input bool methods now fail closed as deprecated unverified queries. Real supplied-sample APIs accept lawful concrete examples and reject the original finite counterexamples with typed errors; the repair is not merely always rejecting every check.
cost_review: Owned input vectors are consumed directly; lengths are captured without counting overflow. Each observation needs one shared input copy for the two consuming routes, with one equality guard, and no cloned sample-vector snapshot. Assoc fmap moves its inner input into h, eliminating the prototype redundant inner clone.

Wrapper work is linear in supplied observations excluding explicit caller Clone/Eq/action/Monad work and destruction costs. Generic fmap may evaluate its callback on multiple elements, so no constant bound on user operations is invented. Maybe itself performs constant constructor/dispatch work plus the selected callback.

Marker constructors are zero-sized data operations; boxed callback/printer adapters allocate their returned Box. The fixed printer allocates the owned String required by its signature. These are source/contract costs, not benchmark or verified zero-allocation claims.
